From those who came in recently

What recent converts recommend

Books that people received into this parish over the last few years say they would hand to someone a year behind them. It is not a course and nobody has approved it as one. It is simply what they found useful, and it is kept separate from the catechism books above for that reason.

Recommended

Toolkit for Spiritual Growth

A Practical Guide to Prayer, Fasting, and Almsgiving
Fr. Evan Armatas · Ancient Faith Publishing

Less about what the Church teaches and more about what to actually do on an ordinary Tuesday — keeping a prayer rule, coming at a fast without dread, giving alms when there is not much to give. Written by a parish priest for people with jobs and children.

Reserve
Proposed — one recommendation so far

The rest of this list is empty on purpose

One book has been named. Nothing has been added to round the list out, because a recommendation nobody made is worth less than a short list that is true. If you were received into the Church here and there is a book you would give someone, say so at the bookstore table and it goes on.

Recommendations are printed without names. No parishioner is named on this page without being asked first.
